overview: Set in the unforgiving, arid borderlands of Chittoor, the narrative centers on Raja, a resilient local whose life is inextricably tied to the harsh realities of his environment. When a fragile peace is shattered by escalating friction between rival factions vying for control over the region's borders, Raja is violently dragged into the crossfire. Pitted against a formidable and ruthless adversary, Gnanendra, the conflict quickly spirals from a localized dispute over territory into a deeply personal, inescapable blood feud. As the violence escalates, Raja must navigate a treacherous landscape of moral ambiguity, fighting not just for dominance, but for fundamental survival.
title: Wild Animals
